stages.name: Intake & Qualification
stages.description: Standardized capture of borrower parameters, revenue, time in business, and credit score.

stages.name: Triage & Underwriting Assessment
stages.description: Instant programmatic evaluation against basic debt service and risk parameters.
stages.leakMetric: 3.5 business days lost on unviable files

stages.name: Document Gathering & Scrubbing
stages.description: Automated collection of 6 months bank statements, P&L, balance sheets, and tax returns.
stages.leakMetric: 68% of deal delays occur waiting on documents
stages.fix: Dedicated borrower upload portal with auto-reminders

stages.name: Financial Spreading & Packaging
stages.description: Parsing transaction data into normalized DSCR, add-backs, and cash flow schedules.
stages.leakMetric: 4.2 hours per file manual spreadsheet entry
stages.fix: OCR statement extraction into standardized credit memo

stages.name: Lender Matching & Routing
stages.description: Mapping borrowing profile against active lender buy boxes and tier preferences.
stages.leakMetric: 52% rejection rate from mismatched lender guidelines

stages.name: Offer Solicitation & Comparison
stages.description: Structuring competing term sheets into transparent APR, factor, and fee schedules.
stages.leakMetric: Borrower confusion leading to abandoned offers

stages.name: Closing & Funding Execution
stages.description: Stipulation clearing, payoff letter verification, and escrow coordination.
stages.leakMetric: Deal fatigue during closing stipulation clearance
stages.fix: Closing checklist tracking with automated lender updates

stages.name: Post-Funding Relationship Equity
stages.description: Automated refinancing triggers, line renewals, and partner attribution tracking.
stages.leakMetric: 82% of repeat borrowing goes to competitors
stages.fix: Milestone-based follow-up triggers at 60 and 120 days
